entity_names: source_name=name observed in current snapshot or null on exit
source_loaded_at: Raw load timestamp, not publication date of official source
export_input: JSON arrays of complete dbt mart rows; DATE and TIMESTAMP serialized as ISO strings; actual dbt run_results.json
export_output: version directory with release.json containing production/entities and manifest.json with candidate status and sha256; never overwrites release or approves it
contribution_display: Select rows where yoy_contribution_selected=true (top 5 positive and top 5 negative rate deltas, ID tie-break), append one Rest with shared yoy_rest_rate_delta from any row in fluid/dimension/periodo. All deltas available for download; client must not sum/recompute Rest.

operator_grouping.semantics: Constant presentation mapping across retained history from Jan2023; no acquired-vendor restatement. Unknown IDs preserve source identity.
row_fields: legal_operator_provenance (array of {idempresa, empresa}, current snapshot; null on absent-current and area rows)
operator_grouping.compatibility: schema_version and all existing fields retained; grouped dbt exports append operator_grouping to release and manifest, legacy exports remain valid without grouping metadata.
operator_grouping.future_drilldown: Operator-by-area/map publication marts must apply this same mapping before aggregation and preserve legal provenance. Those marts are deferred; frontend must not regroup or calculate metrics.

map_extension.anchor: release SHA256 -> release.map.index.sha256 -> index per-file SHA256
map_extension.null_geometry: retain reported rows for equivalent table fallback
map_extension.scope: VM production classified Neuquina; no spatial basin claim
map_extension.index_source_metadata: resource id/url/last_modified, known license or null, quarantined feature counts, date semantics
